Welcome · World's Best Wellness Retreat

Refresh your mind, body and soul at Kairali – The Ayurvedic Healing Village

Welcome to Kairali – The Ayurvedic Healing Village in Palakkad, Kerala. We are a certified wellness retreat offering an authentic Ayurvedic experience for holistic healing. Our 65-acre village is surrounded by lush greenery and coconut trees, providing a serene environment for rejuvenation.

Read more

With a legacy of 25 years, our skilled therapists provide personalized therapies, treatments, and medications based on the ancient wisdom of Ayurveda. Enjoy farm-to-table cuisine with organic, locally sourced ingredients, nourishing your body from within. Engage in daily yoga and meditation sessions for self-discovery and inner peace. Immerse yourself in nature and traditional healing practices at Kairali Ayurvedic Healing Village for a transformative wellness journey.

Discover the Boundless Potential of Kairali and Ayurveda

With over 10,000 successful Ayurveda and Yoga training programs, we're your trusted partner for authentic, transformative education.

Ayurvedic Training Program

Kairali's Ayurvedic wellness retreat offers a comprehensive Ayurvedic Training Program for health and wellness enthusiasts. With over 10,000 programs conducted, we cater to diverse individuals, including spa and wellness experts, homemakers, industry professionals, therapists, doctors, dieticians, managers, students, and Ayurveda enthusiasts.

Training programme →

Ayurvedic Workshop

Discover the transformative power of Ayurveda workshop at the healing village. Immerse yourself in ancient wisdom as expert practitioners guide you through the importance of personalized consultations, herbal remedies, rejuvenating therapies, and yoga sessions.

Yoga & Meditation Training Program

Enhance your well-being with authentic Yoga and meditation practices led by expert teachers. Join our training programs for a holistic Ayurvedic journey or indulge in intensive retreats for seasoned practitioners.

Yoga & meditation training →

Yoga Teacher Training

The Yoga Teacher Training is an immersive course offering comprehensive knowledge of Vedic philosophy and yoga practices. It covers postures, breathing, relaxation, meditation, and diet. Completion leads to certification as an International Yoga Teacher.

Where we are

Palakkad, Kerala — on India's south-west coast

Kerala lies along the Arabian Sea at the southern tip of India, and Palakkad sits inland at the pass through the Western Ghats. The hospital stands on 65 acres of farm and forest an hour from the nearest city.
